verdict.rationale: Rollbar's first-party docs describe Resolve, an AI agent that takes a production error and produces a pull request for review, which matches the story's core of an AI-drafted fix opened as a PR for human review. The evidence is a single short doc statement with no further detail. Missing for 10: details on supported repo hosts and how the repo connection works, a description of how the fix is generated and how good it is, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the PRs are useful.
